decay: cosine to zero at final update
precision: FP16 frozen backbone; FP32 adapters, reader, arbiter, CE; GradScaler

semantic_mapping.full_attention: q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj; q_proj includes the native output-gate channel
semantic_mapping.linear_attention: in_proj_qkv is the fused q/k/v projection; out_proj is the output projection
semantic_mapping.excluded: linear-attention in_proj_z/in_proj_a/in_proj_b, conv, norms, embeddings, vision, MTP

stream: Exact prefix of prior frozen 15M v2 stream; no corpus/order changes
later_arms: Stop at matched 5M decision; 10M REAL only if balanced gate and retention pass; never automatic 15M
fairness: R-REAL and R-DISABLED have identical receiver tensor shapes, initialization, data order, and successful-token budget. Only memory contribution during training differs. Global 15M arms are references, not matched-token comparisons.

retention_diagnostic.order: full first, then general/code/math/scientific/multilingual; original block order
retention_diagnostic.utility_targets: disabled token CE minus real token CE; align alpha_late at logit position predicting each target token
retention_diagnostic.router_utility_ablation: prepare only; never launch or alter the existing CE-trained arbiter

diagnostic_early_stop: If REAL is significantly worse than PERMUTED on the fixed subset, persist the checkpoint and stop REAL immediately; do not advance to another REAL milestone.
extension_schedule: If the 5M gate passes, freeze an independent 5M continuation schedule before proceeding; this controller stops at the matched decision report.
